messages.content: 計算投資回報率，初始投資為$2000，獲利為$500。再計算初始投資為$5000，虧損為$1000的情況。

function.name: calculate_return_on_investment
function.description: Calculate the return on investment given an initial investment and a gain or loss. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_investment.description: The initial amount of money invested.

gain_loss.description: The amount gained or lost. If lose, provide as negative value.
